outcome: Auxologic parameters (bone age to chronological age ratio, predicted adult height)
cohort: Thirty-six children with central precocious puberty (CPP), who were either treatment-naive or had prior GnRHa therapy, were enrolled in a long-term extension phase of a phase 3 clinical trial.
finding: Long-term histrelin implant therapy safely and effectively provided sustained gonadotropin suppression and improved predicted adult height in children with central precocious puberty.
followup_time: Up to 6 years of treatment and up to 1 year of post-treatment follow-up
